</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen the same incident is reported through multiple channels, the Keelwater system creates duplicate claims without warning staff. This splits reserves and confuses adjustments because duplicates go undetected.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Motor and auto insurers** are affected, with Pendleford Motor Mutual stating the system doesn’t alert them when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal [i:037d7fd88bdfe192].\n- **Home and fleet insurers** are also affected, with Hollinbrook Home Insurance and Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reporting the same issue where no system warning appears, creating duplicate records [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932].\n- **Support teams** bear the operational burden, as Tarnholt Drive Cover reports manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid duplicates, which eats up time [i:82e08d8615bf7651].\n\n## Evidence\nThe issue has been raised by 7 accounts across all 3 customer-facing routes: onboarding, sales, and support [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e]. There have been 15 total mentions of the problem [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:603ee96296d14553][i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:7d53d00296e4475f][i:82e08d8615bf7651][i:847e58c1a543471c][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e][i:e662b0d940a820b4][i:f0ce1c1992e87bd2].\n- **Onboarding feedback**: During implementation, Callowfield Auto Assurance noted the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves [i:2b2412a21ba06c15].\n- **Sales feedback**: Sallowmere Motor reported that the same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it [i:0990586a589ee5d4].\n- **Support tickets**: Ravensgill Insurance stated they are getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake [i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. Tarnholt Drive Cover mentioned they have to manually link duplicates after the fact, which delays payments and reporting [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5]. Orrinbury Fleet Insurance also cited disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work [i:e662b0d940a820b4].\n\nThe affected accounts represent a significant portion of revenue. The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from accounts with data is GBP 5220000.0 [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. This includes Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR GBP 690000.0) [i:037d7fd88bdfe192], Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR GBP 1250000.0) [i:2b2412a21ba06c15], Tarnholt Drive Cover (ARR GBP 290000.0) [i:72656010c210a80e], Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR GBP 2400000.0) [i:7572aacb13bfbab0], Orrinbury Fleet Insurance (ARR GBP 120000.0) [i:98da20d057061932], and Ravensgill Insurance (ARR GBP 470000.0) [i:dadf780eadfacb5e].\n\n## Why now\nCustomer mentions have been consistent and recent, spanning from 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-31 [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:f0ce1c1992e87bd2]. The issue is actively impacting operations, as evidenced by ongoing support tickets. Furthermore, 0 renewals have occurred in the last 90 days [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. Several key accounts, including Tarnholt Drive Cover (renewal 2027-01-09) and Hollinbrook Home Insurance (renewal 2027-01-15), have upcoming renewals soon [i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline counts (7 accounts, 15 mentions, 3 routes) against the fact sheet and they match exactly, as do the ARR figures (total GBP 5,220,000 and each per-account value: Pendleford 690k, Callowfield 1.25M, Tarnholt 290k, Hollinbrook 2.4M, Orrinbury 120k, Ravensgill 470k). The date range 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-31 matches the earliest and latest cited insights, and the 0 renewals in 90 days plus the Tarnholt (2027-01-09) and Hollinbrook (2027-01-15) renewal dates are consistent with the fact sheet. Quoted material (e.g., Sallowmere's 'two separate claims with no alert to flag it' and Ravensgill's 'no alert pops up at intake') appears verbatim in the cited insights, and account-level attributions (motor, home, fleet, support burden) are supported by the cited quotes.
